$description: What is enforced by the schema/validator vs. what is convention-only. Every category name here matches a real key in tokens/00-foundation and tokens/10-semantic — not a convenient human label (see MASTER-GUIDE.md 3.21).

enforced.color: A section's `content` fields never carry a raw color value; sections reference semantic roles only, which schema/semantic_validate.py checks by rejecting any hex-looking string in a content field.
enforced.assetRole: Closed enum, schema-enforced (see tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json and schema/pagespec.schema.json definitions.assetRole).
enforced.motion: Closed set of pattern ids from tokens/00-foundation/motion.json, schema-enforced via definitions.motion.

conventionOnly.fontSize: The .type-* utility classes in tokens/00-foundation/typography.json are a documentation-only scale; nothing in the PageSpec schema currently carries a raw pixel size for text, so there is nothing to validate at the PageSpec layer. If a future PageSpec field allows raw typography overrides, this policy must gain an enforced entry and a matching schema/validator check.
conventionOnly.fontWeight: Same as fontSize — variable-font axis values (wght/opsz/SOFT/WONK) are real and cited in tokens/00-foundation/typography.json but are not a PageSpec-level field today.
conventionOnly.elevation: tokens/00-foundation/elevation.json is documentation-only; only two real shadow values exist in the whole project and neither is exposed as a PageSpec field.

overrides.note: PageSpecs in this design-repo carry no per-instance style/token-override field at all (see schema/pagespec.schema.json — nodes reference a section id + content + motion only). Styling is fully owned by the section/component contracts, not by a generated instance. This is recorded here explicitly per MASTER-GUIDE.md 3.21 rather than inventing a token-override mechanism just to have something to validate.

rawValueRestrictions.color: no raw hex/rgb values permitted in any PageSpec content field — enforced (see 'enforced' above)
